40020817.author: पदार्थः
40020817.content: निवर्तमानः while returning, संहृष्टो greatly delighted, रावणस् Ravana, सुदुरात्मवान् the exceedingly wicked one, जह्रे seized, पथि on the way, नरेन्द्रर्षिदेवगन्धर्वकन्यकाः maidens of kings, sages, gods, and gandharvas.

40020817.author: Translation
40020817.content: While returning, the exceedingly wicked Ravana, greatly delighted, abducted maidens of kings, sages, gods, and gandharvas along his path.

40020818.author: पदार्थः
40020818.content: दर्शनीयां beautiful, हि indeed, रक्षः the demon, स he, कन्यां a maiden, स्त्रीं a woman, वापि or even, पश्यति sees, हत्वा having killed, बन्धुजनं the relatives, तस्या her, विमाने in the aerial car, तां her, रुरोध confined, ह indeed.

40020818.author: Translation
40020818.content: Whenever that demon saw a beautiful maiden or woman, he would kill her relatives and then confine her in his aerial car.

40020819.author: पदार्थः
40020819.content: एवं thus, पन्नगकन्याश्च serpent-maidens and, राक्षसासुरमानुषीः demon, asura, and human women, यक्षदानवकन्याश्च yaksha and danava maidens and, विमाने in the aerial car, सो he, अध्यरोपयत् made to ascend.

40020819.author: Translation
40020819.content: In this manner, he also made serpent-maidens, demonesses, asura women, human women, and yaksha and danava maidens ascend into his aerial car.

40020820.author: पदार्थः
40020820.content: ताश्च and they, सर्वाः all, समं together, दुःखान् from sorrow, मुमुचुर् shed, बाष्पजं tears, जलम् water, तुल्यम् resembling, अग्न्यर्चिषां flames of fire, तत्र there, शोकाग्निभयसम्भवम् arising from the fire of sorrow and fear.

40020820.author: Translation
40020820.content: All of them simultaneously shed tears born of sorrow, which resembled flames of fire, arising from the intense sorrow and fear they experienced.

40020821.author: पदार्थः
40020821.content: ताभिः by them, सर्वानवद्याभिः by all blameless ones, नदीभिः by rivers, इव like, सागरः the ocean, आपूरितम् filled, विमानम् the aerial car, तत् that, भयशोकाशिवाश्रुभिः with tears of fear, sorrow, and inauspiciousness.

40020821.author: Translation
40020821.content: That aerial car was filled with the tears of fear, sorrow, and inauspiciousness from those blameless women, just as the ocean is filled by rivers.

40020822.author: पदार्थः
40020822.content: नागगन्धर्वकन्याः daughters of Nagas and Gandharvas, च and, महर्षितनयाः daughters of great sages, च and, याः who, दैत्यदानवकन्याः daughters of Daityas and Danavas, च and, विमाने in the aerial car, शतशः by hundreds, अरुदन् cried.

40020822.author: Translation
40020822.content: Hundreds of daughters of Nagas, Gandharvas, great sages, Daityas, and Danavas were weeping in the aerial car.

40020823.author: पदार्थः
40020823.content: दीर्घकेश्यः with long hair, सुचार्वङ्ग्यः with very beautiful limbs, पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाः with faces resembling the full moon, पीनस्तन्यः with full breasts, तथा and, वज्रवेदिमध्यसमप्रभाः with waists slender like the middle of a sacrificial altar.

40020823.author: Translation
40020823.content: These women possessed long hair, very beautiful limbs, faces like the full moon, full breasts, and waists slender like the middle of a sacrificial altar.

40020824.author: पदार्थः
40020824.content: रथकूबरसङ्काशैः with hips resembling the pole of a chariot, श्रोणिदेशैः with hip regions, मनोहराः charming, स्त्रियः women, सुराङ्गनाप्रख्याः resembling celestial nymphs, निष्टप्तकनकप्रभाः with the radiance of refined gold.

40020824.author: Translation
40020824.content: These charming women, resembling celestial nymphs, had hip regions broad like chariot poles and shone with the radiance of refined gold.

40020825.author: पदार्थः
40020825.content: शोकदुःखभयत्रस्ताः distressed by sorrow, misery, and fear, विह्वलाः agitated, च and, सुमध्यमाः slender-waisted ones, तासाम् of them, निश्वासवातेन by the wind of their sighs, सर्वतः everywhere, सम्प्रदीपितम् was inflamed.

40020825.author: Translation
40020825.content: These slender-waisted women, distressed by sorrow, misery, and fear, were so agitated that the very atmosphere around them was inflamed by the wind of their sighs.

40020826.author: पदार्थः
40020826.content: अग्निहोत्रम् Agnihotra, इव like, आभाति appears, सन्निरुद्धाग्निपुष्पकम् with its fire and flowers restrained, दशग्रीववशम् the control of Daśagrīva, प्राप्ताः having attained, ताः those, तु indeed, शोकाकुलाः distressed with sorrow, स्त्रियः women.

40020826.author: Translation
40020826.content: Those women, having fallen under the sway of Daśagrīva, appeared like an Agnihotra ritual whose fire and flowers have been extinguished, overwhelmed by sorrow.

40020827.author: पदार्थः
40020827.content: दीनवक्रेक्षणाः with sad, curved glances, श्यामाः young women, मृग्यः does, सिंहवशाः the control of a lion, इव like, काचित् some, चिन्तयती thinking, तत्र there, किम् what, नु indeed, माम् me, भक्षयिष्यति will he devour?

40020827.author: Translation
40020827.content: These young women, with their sad, curved glances, were like does under the control of a lion, and some among them wondered if he would devour them.

40020828.author: पदार्थः
40020828.content: काचित् some, दध्यौ thought, सुदुःखार्ता greatly distressed by sorrow, अपि perhaps, माम् me, मारयेत् might kill, अयम् this one, इति thus, मातृपितॄन् mothers and fathers, स्मृत्वा remembering, भर्तॄन् husbands, भ्रातॄन् brothers, तथैव च and similarly, दुःखशोकसमाविष्टाः overcome by pain and sorrow, विलेपुः lamented, सहिताः together, स्त्रियः women.

40020828.author: Translation
40020828.content: Some, greatly distressed, wondered if Rāvaṇa would kill them, and thus, remembering their mothers, fathers, husbands, and brothers, all the women together lamented, overcome by pain and sorrow.

40020829.author: पदार्थः
40020829.content: कथम् how, नु indeed, खलु certainly, मे my, पुत्रः son, भविष्यति will be, मया without me, विना without, कथम् how, माता mother, कथम् how, भ्राता brother, निमग्नाः immersed, शोकसागरे in the ocean of sorrow.

40020829.author: Translation
40020829.content: They lamented, "How will my son fare without me? How will my mother and brother, immersed in an ocean of sorrow, endure?"

40020830.author: पदार्थः
40020830.content: हा alas, कथम् how, नु indeed, करिष्यामि shall I do/live, भर्तुः husband, तस्मात् from that, अहम् I, विना without, मृत्यो O Death, प्रसादयामि I propitiate, त्वाम् you, नय take, माम् me, दुःखभागिनीम् the one sharing sorrow.

40020830.author: Translation
40020830.content: "Alas, how shall I live without that husband? O Death, I implore you, take me, who am burdened with such sorrow."

40020831.author: पदार्थः
40020831.content: किन्नु what indeed, तत् that, दुष्कृतं evil, कर्म deed, पुरा previously, देहान्तरे in another body, कृतम् done,

40020831.author: Translation
40020831.content: What evil deed did we indeed commit in a previous life?

40020832.author: पदार्थः
40020832.content: एवं thus, स्म indeed, दुःखिताः distressed, सर्वाः all, पतिताः fallen, शोकसागरे into the ocean of sorrow, न not, खलु indeed, इदानीं now, पश्यामो we see, दुःखस्य of sorrow, अस्य this, अन्तम् end, आत्मनः of ourselves,

40020832.author: Translation
40020832.content: Thus, all of us are distressed and fallen into an ocean of sorrow, and we indeed see no end to this suffering of ours now.

40020833.author: पदार्थः
40020833.content: अहो alas, धिङ् shame upon, मानुषं human, लोकं world, न not, अस्ति there is, खलु indeed, अधमः lower, परः than, यत् that, दुर्बला weak, बलवता by the strong, भर्तारो husbands, रावणेन by Ravana, नः our,

40020833.author: Translation
40020833.content: Alas, shame upon the human race, for there is indeed nothing lower than this, that our husbands are weak before the mighty Ravana.

40020834.author: पदार्थः
40020834.content: सूर्येण by the sun, उदयता rising, काले at the time, नक्षत्राणीव as if stars, नाशिताः destroyed, अहो alas, सुबलवत् very strong, रक्षो demon, वधोपायेषु in means of killing, युज्यते is engaged,

40020834.author: Translation
40020834.content: Just as stars are destroyed by the rising sun, so too are our husbands, and alas, the very strong demon Ravana is engaged in means of killing.

40020835.author: पदार्थः
40020835.content: अहो alas, दुर्वृत्तम् evil conduct, आस्थाय having resorted to, न not, आत्मानं himself, वै indeed, जुगुप्सते he despises, सर्वथा in every way, सदृशः fitting, तावत् indeed, विक्रमः valor, अस्य his, दुरात्मनः of the wicked one,

40020835.author: Translation
40020835.content: Alas, having resorted to evil conduct, he indeed does not despise himself, and in every way, the valor of this wicked one is indeed fitting.

40020836.author: पदार्थः
40020836.content: इदं this, तु indeed, असदृशं unseemly, कर्म act, परदाराभिमर्शनम् molesting other's wives, यस्मात् because, एष this (one), परक्यासु in other's wives, रमते delights, राक्षसाधमः vilest of Rākṣasas,

40020836.author: Translation
40020836.content: This act of molesting other men's wives is indeed unseemly, because this vilest of Rākṣasas delights in other women.

40020837.author: पदार्थः
40020837.content: तस्मात् therefore, वै indeed, स्त्रीकृतेन by a woman, एव only, प्राप्स्यते will obtain, दुर्मतिः the evil-minded one, वधम् death, सतीभिः by chaste women, वरनारीभिः by excellent women, एवं thus, वाक्ये when the words, अभ्युदीरिते were uttered,

40020837.author: Translation
40020837.content: Therefore, this evil-minded one will indeed meet his death only on account of a woman, thus spoke the chaste and excellent women.

40020838.author: पदार्थः
40020838.content: नेदुः resounded, दुन्दुभयः drums, खस्थाः celestial, पुष्पवृष्टिः shower of flowers, पपात fell, च and, शप्तः cursed, स्त्रीभिः by the women, सः he, तु indeed, समं at the same time, हतौजाः one whose vigor is lost, इव as if, निष्प्रभः lusterless,

40020838.author: Translation
40020838.content: Celestial drums resounded and a shower of flowers fell, and he, cursed by the women, became lusterless as if his vigor was lost.

40020839.author: पदार्थः
40020839.content: पतिव्रताभिः by chaste wives, साध्वीभिः by virtuous women, बभूव became, विमनाः disheartened, इव as if, एवं thus, विलपितं lamentation, तासां of those (women), शृण्वन् listening, राक्षसपुङ्गवः the foremost of Rākṣasas, प्रविवेश entered, पुरीं the city, लङ्कां Lanka, पूज्यमानः being honored, निशाचरैः by the night-wanderers,

40020839.author: Translation
40020839.content: He became as if disheartened by the chaste and virtuous women; listening to their lamentation, the foremost of Rākṣasas entered the city of Lanka, being honored by the night-wanderers.

40020840.author: पदार्थः
40020840.content: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, घोरा terrible, राक्षसी Rākṣasī, कामरूपिणी assuming any form at will, सहसा suddenly, पतिता fell, भूमौ on the ground, भगिनी sister, रावणस्य of Rāvaṇa, सा she,

40020840.author: Translation
40020840.content: In the meantime, that terrible Rākṣasī, Rāvaṇa's sister, who could assume any form at will, suddenly fell on the ground.

40020841.author: पदार्थः
40020841.content: तां her, स्वसारं sister, समुत्थाप्य having raised up, रावणः Ravana, परिसान्त्वयन् consoling, अब्रवीत् said, किम् what, इदं this, भद्रे O gentle one, वक्तुकामा desirous of speaking, असि you are, मे to me, द्रुतम् quickly,

40020841.author: Translation
40020841.content: Ravana, having raised his sister up and consoled her, asked her what she quickly wished to tell him.

40020842.author: पदार्थः
40020842.content: सा she, बाष्पपरिरुद्धाक्षी with eyes obstructed by tears, रक्ताक्षी with red eyes, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, कृता made, अस्मि I am, विधवा a widow, राजन् O king, त्वया by you, बलवता powerful one, बलात् by force,

40020842.author: Translation
40020842.content: With her eyes red and obstructed by tears, she spoke, saying, "O king, I have been forcibly made a widow by you, the powerful one."

40020843.author: पदार्थः
40020843.content: एते these, राजन् O king, त्वया by you, वीराः brave ones, दैत्याः Daityas, विनिहताः killed, रणे in battle, कालकेयाः Kalakeyas, इति thus, ख्याताः known, सहस्राणि thousands, चतुर्दश fourteen,

40020843.author: Translation
40020843.content: O king, these brave Daityas, known as the fourteen thousand Kalakeyas, were killed by you in battle.

40020844.author: पदार्थः
40020844.content: प्राणेभ्यः than life, अपि even, गरीयान् dearer, मे to me, तत्र there, भर्ता husband, महाबलः mighty-armed,

40020844.author: Translation
40020844.content: Among them was my mighty-armed husband, who was dearer to me even than my own life.

40020845.author: पदार्थः
40020845.content: सः he, अपि even, त्वया by you, हतः killed, तात O dear one, रिपुणा by an enemy, भ्रातृगृध्नुना hostile to kinsmen, त्वया by you, अस्मि I am, निहता killed, राजन् O king, स्वयम् myself, एव indeed, हि certainly, बन्धुना by a kinsman,

40020845.author: Translation
40020845.content: O dear one, even he was killed by you, an enemy hostile to your own kin; O king, I myself have certainly been destroyed by you, my own kinsman.

40020846.author: पदार्थः
40020846.content: राजन् Rajan (O King), वैधव्यशब्दं vaidhavyaśabdaṃ (the word 'widowhood'), च ca (and), भोक्ष्यामि bhokṣyāmi (I shall experience), त्वत्कृते tvatkṛte (because of you), हि hi (indeed), अहम् aham (I); ननु nanu (surely), नाम nāma (indeed), त्वया tvayā (by you), रक्ष्यो rakṣyo (to be protected), जामाता jāmātā (a son-in-law), समरेष्वपि samareṣvapi (even in battles); स sa (he), त्वया tvayā (by you), निहतो nihato (was killed), युद्धे yuddhe (in battle), स्वयमेव svayameva (by yourself), न na (not), लज्जसे lajjase (are you ashamed).

40020846.author: Translation
40020846.content: The speaker laments that she will become a widow because of the king's actions, questioning how he could kill his own son-in-law in battle, whom he was supposed to protect, without any shame.

40020847.author: पदार्थः
40020847.content: एवम् evam (thus), उक्तो ukto (addressed), दशग्रीवो daśagrīvo (Dashagriva, Ravana), भगिन्या bhaginyā (by his sister), क्रोशमानया krośamānayā (who was wailing), अब्रवीत् abravīt (spoke), सान्त्वयित्वा sāntvayitvā (having consoled), तां tāṃ (her), सामपूर्वम् sāmapūrvam (with soothing words), इदं idaṃ (this), वचः vacaḥ (speech).

40020847.author: Translation
40020847.content: Thus addressed by his wailing sister, Ravana consoled her and spoke these soothing words.

40020848.author: पदार्थः
40020848.content: अलम् alam (enough), वत्से vatse (O child), रुदित्वा ruditvā (by weeping), ते te (for you); न na (not), भेतव्यं bhetavyaṃ (to be feared), च ca (and), सर्वशः sarvaśaḥ (in any way); दानमानप्रसादैः dānamānaprasādaiḥ (with gifts, honors, and favors), त्वां tvāṃ (you), तोषयिष्यामि toṣayiṣyāmi (I shall satisfy), यत्नतः yatnataḥ (with effort).

40020848.author: Translation
40020848.content: Ravana told her to stop weeping and not to fear, promising to satisfy her with great effort through gifts, honors, and favors.

40020849.author: पदार्थः
40020849.content: युद्धप्रमत्तो yuddhapramatto (intoxicated by battle), व्याक्षिप्तो vyākṣipto (distracted), जयाकाङ्क्षी jayākāṅkṣī (desiring victory), क्षिपञ्छरान् kṣipañcharān (hurling arrows), न na (not), अवगच्छामि avagacchāmi (I distinguish), युद्धेषु yuddheṣu (in battles), स्वान् svān (my own people), परान् parānvā (or enemies), अपि api (even), अहं ahaṃ (I), शुभे śubhe (O auspicious one).

40020849.author: Translation
40020849.content: Ravana explained that in the heat of battle, intoxicated and distracted by the desire for victory while showering arrows, he cannot distinguish between his own people and enemies.

40020850.author: पदार्थः
40020850.content: जामातरं jāmātaraṃ (the son-in-law), न na (not), जाने jāne (I knew), स्म sma (indeed), प्रहरन् praharan (while striking), युद्धदुर्मदः yuddhadurmadaḥ (intoxicated by the frenzy of battle); तेन tena (therefore), असौ asau (he), निहतः nihataḥ (was killed), सङ्ख्ये saṅkhye (in battle), मया mayā (by me), भर्ता bhartā (the husband), तव tava (your), स्वसः svasaḥ (O sister).

40020850.author: Translation
40020850.content: Ravana confessed that, maddened by the battle, he did not recognize his son-in-law while striking and thus inadvertently killed her husband in the conflict.

40020851.author: पदार्थः
40020851.content: अस्मिन्काले in this time, तु indeed, यत्प्राप्तं whatever is appropriate, तत्करिष्यामि that I will do, ते for you, हितम् beneficial. भ्रातुः of the brother, ऐश्वर्ययुक्तस्य endowed with power, खरस्य of Khara, वस dwell, पार्श्वतः by the side.

40020851.author: Translation
40020851.content: At this time, I will do what is beneficial for you; dwell by the side of your brother Khara, who is endowed with power.

40020852.author: पदार्थः
40020852.content: चतुर्दशानां of fourteen, सहस्राणां of thousands, ते your, भ्राता brother, भविष्यति will be. प्रभुः the lord, प्रयाणे in marching, दाने in giving, च and, राक्षसानां of rakshasas, महाबलः very powerful.

40020852.author: Translation
40020852.content: Your brother will be the lord of fourteen thousand very powerful Rakshasas, commanding them in expeditions and bestowing gifts.

40020853.author: पदार्थः
40020853.content: तत्र there, ते your, मातृष्वसेयः cousin (son of mother's sister), अयं this, वै indeed, भ्राता brother, खरः Khara, प्रभुः the lord, भविष्यति will be, निशाचरः the night-wanderer, सदा always, तवादेशं your command, कुर्वन् executing.

40020853.author: Translation
40020853.content: There, your cousin and brother Khara, the lordly night-wanderer, will always execute your commands.

40020854.author: पदार्थः
40020854.content: शीघ्रं quickly, अयं this, वीरः hero, दण्डकान् to the Dandaka forest, परिरक्षितुम् to protect, गच्छतु let him go. दूषणः Dushana, अस्य his, बलाध्यक्षः commander of forces, भविष्यति will be, महाबलः very powerful.

40020854.author: Translation
40020854.content: Let this hero quickly go to protect the Dandaka forest, and the very powerful Dushana will be his commander of forces.

40020855.author: पदार्थः
40020855.content: तत्र there, शूरः the brave, खरः Khara, ते your, वचनं command, सदा always, करिष्यति will execute. एषः this one, कामरूपाणां who can change form at will, रक्षसां of rakshasas, प्रभुः the lord, भविष्यति will be.

40020855.author: Translation
40020855.content: There, the brave Khara will always execute your commands, and he will be the lord of the Rakshasas who can change their form at will.

40020856.author: पदार्थः
40020856.content: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva (Ravana), सैन्यम् army, अस्य to him (Khara), आदिदेश ordered, ह indeed, चतुर्दश fourteen, सहस्राणि thousands, रक्षसाम् of Rakshasas, वीर्यशालिनाम् valorous.

40020856.author: Translation
40020856.content: Having spoken thus, Dashagriva (Ravana) indeed ordered an army of fourteen thousand valorous Rakshasas for Khara.

40020857.author: पदार्थः
40020857.content: सः he (Khara), तैः by them, परिवृतः surrounded, सर्वैः all, राक्षसैः by Rakshasas, घोरदर्शनैः of terrible appearance, आगच्छत came, खरः Khara, शीघ्रम् quickly, दण्डकान् to Dandaka forest, अकुतोभयः fearless.

40020857.author: Translation
40020857.content: Surrounded by all those Rakshasas of terrible appearance, Khara quickly and fearlessly came to the Dandaka forest.

40020858.author: पदार्थः
40020858.content: सः he (Khara), तत्र there, कारयामास established, राज्यम् kingdom, निहतकण्टकम् free from enemies, सा she, च and, शूर्पणखा Shurpanakha, तत्र there, न्यवसत् resided, दण्डकावने in the Dandaka forest.

40020858.author: Translation
40020858.content: Khara established a kingdom free from enemies there, and Shurpanakha also resided in the Dandaka forest. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चतुर्विंशः सर्गः ।। 24 ।। Thus ends the twenty-fourth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
